risks: Critical source/spec contradiction: personalTasks handler comment says LOCAL_ONLY but actual routing classifies all five channels REMOTE_ELIGIBLE. The available localElectron access gate is not opted into; no owner check exists in handlers. This is source evidence, not a demonstrated remote exploit.
Authenticated transport connection is not authenticated principal identity: boolean token/cookie validation and clientId/workspaceId cannot authorize personal ownership.

The two normative new product modules and two shared files cannot by themselves deliver a mounted renderer picker, all-locale translations or complete typed transport/revoke wiring. Do not mark UI criteria N/A or substitute isolated fixtures.

Existing monotonic task revisions and tmp+rename are not binding CAS or an atomic command/receipt/outbox transaction; unguarded check/write can lose acknowledged changes and emit unrecoverable events.
PersonalTask.source is a semantic TaskLink, not sourceStoreId/ownerPrincipalId; treating it as authority would conflate provenance and permission.

Existing Map registration enforces workspace mismatch quarantine; cross-workspace source projections must follow explicit approved binding semantics rather than bypassing quarantine or sharing on import.
Migration deduplication and marker are root-local, while snapshots include tasks and meta; projecting the unchanged migration result to another principal leaks private content.
All-client changed events and buffered replay need recipient policy fencing; no protected title/count is acceptable even after revocation or in source picker summaries.
